Which statements about the substances in water from natural sources are correct?
1
Detergents contain nitrates that cause disease.
2
Sewage contains harmful microbes that cause disease.
3
All metal compounds are toxic.
4
Fertilisers contain nitrates and phosphates which damage aquatic life.
A
B
C
D
1 and 3
1 and 4
2 and 3
2 and 4
